currentParagraphText: “Oh, and ensure to keep enough land open to provide a space worthy of a Chosen,” Viridia said before finally dismissing the dragonkin.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Oh, and ensure to keep enough land open to provide a space worthy of a Chosen,” Viridia said before finally dismissing the dragonkin.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: With him gone, Viridia went over to a crystal tablet that helped record the number of slots the Order of the Malefic Viper currently possessed. While they had plenty for A-grades and below, they barely had any for S-grades.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: If the Chosen of the Malefic Viper was coming, she had to ensure the place was at least presentable... because currently, she was standing in one of the few completed buildings.
